ORDER This appeal by the claimant under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of the award dated 01.08.2019 passed by 4th Additional MACT, Khargone in Claim Case No.162/2018 seeking enhancement of compensation awarded by the Tribunal.
2. The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability are not in dispute and the findings recorded by the Tribunal in this regard are also not in question.

As per the findings of the Tribunal,
for the death of Manish, the Tribunal has awarded a total compensation of Rs.7,10,400/- along with interest.

The breakup of the compensation amount is as under:
 HEAD AMOUNT  Loss of dependency -Rs.6,80,400  Funeral expenses -Rs.15,000/-
 Loss of estate -Rs.15,000/-
 ------------
 TOTAL Rs.7,10,400/
3.

Learned counsel for the appellants submits that the Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case as the amount awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side.
The deceased was working as cleaner in the offending vehicle and was earning Rs.9000/- per month.
However, the Tribunal has wrongly assessed the income of the deceased as Rs.4500/- and assessed the amount of compensation.
The Tribunal has also committed an error in not awarding any sum under the head of consortium to the claimants/parents.

Hence,
prays for awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company has argued in support of the impugned award and contended that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation amount in the case which does not call for any interference by this Court.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, I find substance in the arguments advanced by the counsel for the appellant.

Admittedly, at the time of accident the Sobharam vs Sohan on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169435900/
2 deceased was working as cleaner in the truck that met with an accident and deceased Manish died in the accident.

sentences.text: The Tribunal has assessed the income of the deceased as Rs.4500/- per month only for the reason that no document has been produced by the claimants regarding the income of the deceased.

Although there was no proof regarding the income of the deceased, still the Tribunal ought to have assessed the income of the deceased on the basis of the relevant circular regarding the minimum wages prescribed for an unskilled labour.

Apart from that, the Tribunal has also not awarded any sum under the head of consortium to the parents keeping in view the verdict of the Apex Court in the case of Magma General Insurance Co. Ltd. vs. Nanu Ram @ Chuhru Ram & others reported in (2018) 18 SCC 130.

entities.text: Magma General Insurance Co. Ltd. vs. Nanu Ram @ Chuhru Ram & others reported in (2018) 18 SCC 130
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the above, the compensation awarded by the Tribunal deserves to be modified as under:
 HEAD AMOUNT  Loss of dependency -Rs.9,82,800/-
(i.e. Rs.6500 +40% FP x 12 - 1/2 personal expenses x 18 (multiplier)) Loss of consortium -Rs.88,000/-
 Funeral expenses -Rs.16,500/-
 Loss of estate -Rs.16,500/-
 ------------------
 TOTAL Rs.11,03,800/-
7.
Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.11,03,800/- as against the award of the Tribunal of Rs.7,10,400/-.
Accordingly, the appellants are entitled to an additional sum of Rs.3,93,400/- over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.
8. In the result, the appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation amount by a sum of Rs.3,93,400/-.
The enhanced amount shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.
9. The appellants have valued the appeal only to the extent of Rs.3 lakhs and paid the Court fee accordingly.

However, for the remaining amount, the Court fee shall be paid by the appellants within a period of one month and thereafter the amount shall be released by the Insurance Company on receiving the certificate.

In case the certificate has not been filed before the Insurance Company up to a period of three months, the claimant shall not be entitled to receive the interest on the enhanced amount of compensation.
10. In the result, the appeal is allowed in part and to the extent indicated herein above.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE hk/
